originals.ko: 다음 모퉁이에서 초록색 셔츠를 입은 그 남자아이

originals.why: Wrong sense for the preposition: 'too close to the next corner' is 'rhy agos at y gornel nesa’' in Welsh. 'yn rhy agos wrth y gornel nesa’' reads as an unanchored 'too close' plus 'at the next corner', which is not idiomatic and has no clear meaning on its own.
